<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000839" name="us-gaap:InvestmentTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80B_eus-gaap--InvestmentTextBlock_z3kL0waeEFG9" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>6.
<span id="xdx_829_zmgBpZMMqIzd">Investment in NexGelRx</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
December 11, 2025, the Company completed the disposition of a controlling interest in its dormant subsidiary, NexgelRX, Inc. (&#8220;NexgelRX&#8221;), and retained a <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByParent_iI_pid_dp_c20251211__srt--OwnershipAxis__custom--NexgelRXMember_zLYjKydlu3re" title="Minority interest ownership percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByParent" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-11_custom_NexgelRXMember" id="Fact000841" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">19.99</ix:nonFraction></span>% non-controlling interest through a convertible preferred stock holding, which is non-dilutive up to $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--MinorityInterestAmountRepresentedByPreferredStock_iI_pn5n6_c20251211__srt--ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis__custom--NexgelRXMember_zYB3AnFBo6eh" title="Minority interest amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:MinorityInterestAmountRepresentedByPreferredStock" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-11_custom_NexgelRXMember28067515" id="Fact000843" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">8.0</ix:nonFraction></span> million
of third-party capital raised. NexgelRX focuses exclusively on developing and commercializing prescription drug delivery solutions utilizing
the Company&#8217;s proprietary hydrogel technology. At the time of the disposition, NexgelRX raised approximately $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestments_pn4n6_c20251211__20251211__srt--ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis__custom--NexgelRXMember_zBK9PnQOy3dg" title="Proceeds from investments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestments" contextRef="From2025-12-112025-12-11_custom_NexgelRXMember" id="Fact000845" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.25</ix:nonFraction></span> million from
third-party investors. In connection with the transaction, the Company granted NexgelRX a license to its technology and is entitled to
receive a 5% royalty on future product sales.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company evaluated NexgelRX under ASC 810 and concluded that it is not a variable interest entity because it has sufficient substantive
equity investment at risk, including third-party equity, to finance its activities without additional subordinated financial support.
The Company uses the measurement alternative for equity investments with no readily determinable fair value and the investment is reported
at cost, adjusted for impairments or any observable price changes in ordinary transactions with identical or similar investments. The
Company valued its convertible preferred stock interest at $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--OtherAssets_iI_pn3n3_c20251231_zxczoDJlrJN2"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OtherAssets" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000846" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">249</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand, which is reported on the Consolidated Balance
Sheets and a gain on spin-off of NexGelRx for the year ended December 31, 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
part of the transaction, the Company issued <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights_iI_pid_c20251231_zd7YnokfVqde" title="Warrant issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000848" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">125,000</ix:nonFraction></span></span>
<span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">warrants to purchase its common stock at an exercise price
of $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_pid_c20251231_zsuunI5XEPG" title="Warrant exercise price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000850" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">4.00</ix:nonFraction></span></span>
<span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">per share, with a five-year term. <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightReasonForIssuingToNonemployees_c20250101__20251231_zhqsCLVt08N2" title="Warrant description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact000852" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightReasonForIssuingToNonemployees">The warrants represent approximately
10% warrant coverage relative to the Investee&#8217;s capital raise and were classified as equity under ASC 815-40. The warrants were
valued at $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--WarrantsAndRightsOutstanding_iI_pn3n3_c20251231_zQq5Kvmo2Lah" title="Warrant issued, value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:WarrantsAndRightsOutstanding" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000854" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">87</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand using the Black-Scholes option model</ix:nonNumeric></span>, and such amount was recorded as additional paid-in capital with
a corresponding decrease in the gain in spin-off of NexGelRx.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000856" name="us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_807_eus-gaap--VariableInterestEntityDisclosureTextBlock_zecgJo2ePl81" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>7.
<span id="xdx_826_zqTUhjNbEJ98">Variable interest entities</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Interest
in Joint Venture &#8211; CGN</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
March 1, 2023, the Company acquired a <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230301__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--CGConvertingAndPackagingLLCMember_zWDWnOp16Q4f" title="Acquisition percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" contextRef="AsOf2023-03-01_custom_CGConvertingAndPackagingLLCMember" id="Fact000858" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>% interest in the CGN JV (see Note 1). The CGN JV is owned <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230301__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--CGConvertingAndPackagingLLCMember_zDeky2XblXf3" title="Acquisition percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" contextRef="AsOf2023-03-01_custom_CGConvertingAndPackagingLLCMember" id="Fact000860" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>% by the Company and <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230301__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--CGLaboratoriesIncMember_zlRAjlRcD0r3" title="Acquisition percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" contextRef="AsOf2023-03-01_custom_CGLaboratoriesIncMember" id="Fact000862" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>% by CG Labs.
CG Labs contributed its existing converting and packaging division to the CGN JV, including, but not limited to, its facilities, equipment,
employees, and customers. The Company will contribute $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired_pn3n3_c20230301__20230301__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--CGConvertingAndPackagingLLCMember_ze4009y2K2D5" title="Payment to acquire business"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired" contextRef="From2023-03-012023-03-01_custom_CGConvertingAndPackagingLLCMember" id="Fact000864" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">500</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand to the CGN JV, on a schedule to be determined, to be used for equipment
and facility upgrades as well as general corporate purposes for the CGN JV.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
CGN JV is considered to be a VIE and we have consolidated the CGN JV, because we believe we are the primary beneficiary and we
meet the power and the economics criteria.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Interest
in Joint Venture &#8211; Enigma</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
January 6, 2023, the Company acquired a<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230106__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember_znShzY5B5aig" title="Acquisition percentage">
<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" contextRef="AsOf2023-01-06_custom_EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember" id="Fact000866" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>% interest in a newly formed joint venture (the &#8220;Enigma JV&#8221;) to pursue branded consumer product retail
opportunities and the development of new patch products. The Enigma JV agreement was effective January 6, 2023. As a result of this
transaction, the Company owned <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230106__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember_zs2dE1AzRl2b" title="Acquisition percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" contextRef="AsOf2023-01-06_custom_EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember" id="Fact000868" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>%
of the Enigma JV, with the remaining <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230106__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--MoietyMember_z9knLzvSCwb" title="Acquisition percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" contextRef="AsOf2023-01-06_custom_MoietyMember" id="Fact000870" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>%
held by Moiety. However, the Enigma JV was dissolved on December 23, 2024. As of December 31, 2024, the Company had contributed
$<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember_zOxcU9nxF6Re" title="Payment to acquire business"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember" id="Fact000872" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">20</ix:nonFraction></span>
thousand and the non-controlling interest portion of Enigma JV had contributed $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--MinorityInterest_iI_pn3n3_c20241231__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember_zN2Pq3PU1A8j" title="Minority interest"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:MinorityInterest" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_EnigmaHealthJointVentureMember" id="Fact000874" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">37</ix:nonFraction></span>
thousand.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
February 2024, the CGN JV entered into a lease agreement for certain equipment under separate non-cancelable equipment loan and
security agreements. The agreement matures in January 2030. The agreements require monthly payments of principal and interest
through maturity and are secured by the assets under the lease. As of <span style="text-decoration: underline double">December </span>31,
2025, $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAsset_iI_pn3n3_c20251231__us-gaap--FairValueByAssetClassAxis__us-gaap--PropertyPlantAndEquipmentMember_zv6O4f6kEyg6" title="Financing lease liability included in property and equipment"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAsset" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_us-gaap_PropertyPlantAndEquipmentMember" id="Fact001002" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">419</ix:nonFraction></span>
thousand is included in the property and equipment on the balance sheet. The weighted average interest rate was <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageDiscountRatePercent_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20251231_zyAG4Jgs9MUb" title="Weighted average interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageDiscountRatePercent" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001004" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">9.1</ix:nonFraction></span>%
and <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageDiscountRatePercent_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20251231_zf5RwvtuQVu2" title="Weighted average interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageDiscountRatePercent" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001006" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">9.1</ix:nonFraction>%</span> and the weighted average remaining lease term was <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageRemainingLeaseTerm1_iI_dtY_c20251231_zvanAtgNEpae" title="Weighted average remaining lease term"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001008" name="us-gaap:FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageRemainingLeaseTerm1">4.1</ix:nonNumeric></span> years and <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageRemainingLeaseTerm1_iI_dtY_c20241231_znvk6q42bya6" title="Weighted average remaining lease term"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001010" name="us-gaap:FinanceLeaseWeightedAverageRemainingLeaseTerm1">5.1</ix:nonNumeric></span> years at
December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A9_zwshCuNSzQde" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Generally,
the Company enters into subscription agreements with investors for the sale of its common stock, accompanied with the issuance warrants
to acquire common stock.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Subject
to certain ownership limitations, each of the warrants will become exercisable on the respective closing date and will expire after<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingTerm_iI_dc_c20250731__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__custom--RegisteredDirectOfferingMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SubscriptionAgreementsMember_zBFQjaakPtUc" title="Warrants term"> <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2025-07-31_custom_RegisteredDirectOfferingMember_custom_SubscriptionAgreementsMember" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Fact001243" name="us-gaap:WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingTerm">five
years</ix:nonNumeric></span>. The warrants may only be exercised on a cashless basis if there is no registration statement registering, or the prospectus contained
in the registration statement is not available for the issuance or resale of shares of common stock underlying the warrants to or by
the holder. The holder of a warrant is prohibited from exercising any such warrants to the extent that such exercise would result in
the number of shares of common stock beneficially owned by such holder and its affiliates exceeding <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--BeneficialInterestCommonStockOwnershipPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250731__20250731__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__custom--RegisteredDirectOfferingMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SubscriptionAgreementsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zZ4KuFgshGk4" title="Beneficial interest common stock ownership percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="NXGL:BeneficialInterestCommonStockOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="From2025-07-312025-07-31_custom_RegisteredDirectOfferingMember_custom_SubscriptionAgreementsMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001245" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">4.99</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the total number of shares
of common stock outstanding immediately after giving effect to the exercise, which percentage may be increased or decreased at the holder&#8217;s
election not to exceed <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--BeneficialInterestThresholdPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250731__20250731__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__custom--RegisteredDirectOfferingMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SubscriptionAgreementsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zSYWsOu2sGh8" title="Beneficial interest threshold percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="NXGL:BeneficialInterestThresholdPercentage" contextRef="From2025-07-312025-07-31_custom_RegisteredDirectOfferingMember_custom_SubscriptionAgreementsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001247" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">9.99</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A4_zGfolMXW4Tlj" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company does not have sufficient historical information to develop reasonable expectations about future exercise patterns and post-vesting
employment termination behavior. Accordingly, the Company has elected to use the &#8220;simplified method&#8221; to estimate the expected
term of its share-based awards. The simplified method computes the expected term as the sum of the award&#8217;s vesting term plus the
original contractual term divided by two.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company estimated the expected volatility input for the Black-Scholes model using the historical volatility of its own publicly traded
common stock over a period commensurate with the expected term of the option.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>




<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company recognizes compensation expense for stock option awards on a straight-line basis over the applicable service period of the award.
The service period is generally the vesting period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Restricted
stock awards</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Compensation
expense will be recognized ratably over the total vesting schedule. The Company will periodically adjust the cumulative compensation
expense for forfeited awards. The Company recognizes the reversal of any previously recognized compensation expense on forfeited awards
in the period the awards are forfeited. As of December 31, 2025, there was $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions_iI_pn3n3_c20251231__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__us-gaap--RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember_zAa9HMUpTYHd" title="Unrecognized share based compensation expense"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_us-gaap_RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember" id="Fact001443" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">38</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand unrecognized share-based compensation related
to unvested RSUs, which the Company expects to recognize through December 2027.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Share-based

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001612" name="us-gaap:DerivativesAndFairValueTextBlock"><p id="xdx_802_eus-gaap--DerivativesAndFairValueTextBlock_zs6GTFVHMMBj" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>17.&#8239;<span id="xdx_82A_zZveolrGOVU4">Warrant
Liability</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company issued approximately <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding_iI_pid_c20191231__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zO0FKUyAYbQ1" title="Number of warrants issued"><span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding_iI_pid_c20201231__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zE4CXP8mWej2" title="Number of warrants issued"><span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding_iI_pid_c20211231__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zT6suEOaASzd" title="Number of warrants issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding" contextRef="AsOf2019-12-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001614" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding" contextRef="AsOf2020-12-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001616" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding" contextRef="AsOf2021-12-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001618" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">265,000</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span></span></span> warrants in 2019, 2020 and 2021 as equity issuance consideration, in connection with equity offerings
of the Company&#8217;s common stock. The warrants entitle the holder to purchase one share of our common stock at an exercise price equal
to $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_pid_c20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zpWQRCe2fwDe" title="Exercise price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001620" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.49</ix:nonFraction></span> to $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_pid_c20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zk7TzKelm2Jc" title="Exercise price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_srt_MaximumMember_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001622" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">5.25</ix:nonFraction></span> per share at any time on or after their issuance date and on or prior to the close of business three to five years
after the issuance date (the &#8220;Termination Date&#8221;). The Company determined that these warrants are free standing financial
instruments that are legally detachable and separately exercisable from the common stock included in the public share offering. Management
also determined that the warrants required classification as a liability pursuant to ASC 815, <i>Derivatives and Hedging</i>. In accordance
with the accounting guidance, the outstanding warrants are recognized as a warrant liability on the balance sheet and are measured at
their inception date fair value and subsequently re-measured at each reporting period with changes being recorded as a component of other
income (expense) in the consolidated statements of operations.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Partnership
Advance</i></span></p>

consumer health. The expansion included a $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromPartnershipContribution_pn6n6_c20250714__20250714_zHpxXc0iVRll" title="Partnership accrued advance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromPartnershipContribution" contextRef="From2025-07-142025-07-14" id="Fact001704" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1</ix:nonFraction></span> million advance from STADA to the Company in non-dilutive capital to support product launches

formulas and solutions targeting scars and stretch marks. <p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Litigation</i></span></p>

effect on the financial position, results of operations, or cash flows of the Company.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A9_zialH7RkDtM2" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company has approximately $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_z2OLbG2Kt5Wl" title="Deferred tax assets, operating loss carryforwards, state and local"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001829" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">23.6</ix:nonFraction></span> million and $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal_iI_pn5n6_c20241231_zHeeZ53o440b" title="Deferred tax assets, operating loss carryforwards, state and local"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001831" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">21.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million of federal NOL carryovers, respectively,
which begin to expire in 2029 through 2037. Similarly, the subsidiary&#8217;s Pennsylvania state returns reported state NOL carryovers
of approximately $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__srt--StatementGeographicalAxis__country--PA_zuIKrlJs34Mf" title="Deferred tax assets, operating loss carryforwards, state and local"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_country_PA" id="Fact001833" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">23.6</ix:nonFraction></span> million and $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal_iI_pn5n6_c20241231__srt--StatementGeographicalAxis__country--PA_zD6Ai2ETdDO2" title="Deferred tax assets, operating loss carryforwards, state and local"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_country_PA" id="Fact001835" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">21.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million, as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. However, these loss carryforwards on
a separate company basis may be subject to limitations on the amounts that may be utilized pursuant to Internal Revenue Code section
382 and applicable state law. Section 382 imposes significant limitations on the utilization of net operating losses after certain changes
of corporate ownership. The Company will need to determine the amount of loss carryforwards that may be utilized in the future as necessary.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
assessing the realization of deferred tax assets, management considers whether it is more likely than not that some portion or all of
the deferred tax assets will be realized. The ultimate realization of the deferred tax assets is dependent upon the future generation
of taxable income during the years in which those temporary differences become deductible. Management considers the scheduled reversal
of deferred tax liabilities, projected future taxable income and tax planning strategies in making this assessment. After consideration
of all the evidence, both positive and negative, management has recorded a full valuation allowance against net deferred tax assets at
December 31, 2025 and 2024 because management has determined that it is more likely than not that these deferred tax assets will not
be realized.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company is subject to taxation in the U.S. and various states. Based on the history of net operating losses all jurisdictions and tax
years are open for examination until the operating losses are utilized or the statute of limitations expires. As of December 31, 2025
and 2024, the Company does not have any significant uncertain tax positions.</span></p>

A Convertible Notes and the Series B Convertible Notes, and the description of the terms of the Convertible Notes set forth below applies
equally to both series unless otherwise indicated.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Convertible Notes bear interest at a rate of <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20260209__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SecuritiesPurchaseAgreementMember__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zp3kbFeDRFck" title="Interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2026-02-09_custom_SecuritiesPurchaseAgreementMember_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" id="Fact001848" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">10</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum (increasing to <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20260209__20260209__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SecuritiesPurchaseAgreementMember__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zLWfHokNFEre" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2026-02-092026-02-09_custom_SecuritiesPurchaseAgreementMember_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" id="Fact001850" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">18</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum upon the occurrence and during the continuance
of an Event of Default), with interest payable monthly on the first Trading Day of each calendar month commencing May 1, 2026. Each Convertible
Note will mature on the two (2) year anniversary of the applicable issuance date, subject to adjustment if certain conditions with respect
to the Approved Acquisition are not met.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

Series A Convertible Notes are convertible into shares of Common Stock at a fixed Conversion Price of $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1_iI_pid_c20260501__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zx6dBFCGmWOj" title="Debt conversion price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" contextRef="AsOf2026-05-01_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" id="Fact001852" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">1.244</ix:nonFraction></span> per share, subject to adjustment
as provided in the Series A Convertible Notes. The holder may elect to convert the Convertible Notes at an Alternate Conversion Price,
subject to certain conditions, which provides for conversion at a discounted price based on recent trading VWAP. The Alternate Optional
Conversion Price is equal to the lower of (i) the Conversion Price or (ii) the greater of (x) the Floor Price (as defined below) or (y)
95% of the average VWAP during the ten (10) consecutive Trading Day period ending on the trading day immediately preceding delivery of
the conversion notice. The Alternate Event of Default Conversion Price is equal to the lower of (i) the Conversion Price or (ii) the
greater of (x) the Floor Price or (y) 80% of the average VWAP during the ten (10) consecutive trading day period ending on the trading
day immediately preceding delivery of the conversion notice. <p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Asset
Purchase and Exclusive License Agreement</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="item_013"></span>Item
9. Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and Financial Disclosure</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">None.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="item_014"></span>Item
9A. Controls and Procedures</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Disclosure
Controls and Procedures</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025, we conducted an evaluation of the effectiveness of our &#8220;disclosure controls and procedures&#8221; (&#8220;Disclosure
Controls&#8221;), as defined by Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#8220;Exchange
Act&#8221;). The Disclosure Controls evaluation was done under the supervision and with the participation of management, including our
chief executive officer and chief financial officer. There are inherent limitations to the effectiveness of any system of disclosure
controls and procedures. Accordingly, even effective disclosure controls and procedures can only provide reasonable assurance of achieving
their control objectives. Our management, with the participation of our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, evaluated
the effectiveness of our disclosure controls and procedures as of December 31, 2025. Based on that evaluation, our CEO and CFO concluded
that our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective as of December 31, 2025, due to material weaknesses in our internal control
over financial reporting, which are described below in &#8220;Management&#8217;s Annual Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting&#8221;.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Management&#8217;s
Annual Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting and Attestation Report of the Registered Accounting Firm</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Our
management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting (as defined in Rule 13a-15(f)
under the Exchange Act). Management conducted an assessment of the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting based
on the criteria set forth in Internal Control&#8212;Integrated Framework issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway
Commission (2013 framework). Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting is not intended to provide
absolute assurance that a misstatement of our financial statements would be prevented or detected. Based on that assessment, management
has concluded that its internal control over financial reporting was not effective as of December 31, 2025 to provide reasonable assurance
regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements in accordance with accounting principles
generally accepted in the United States of America. Specifically, management has concluded that its internal control over financial reporting
was not effective as of December 31, 2025 to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation
of financial statements in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America due to not maintaining
proper segregation of duties, including: (i) we have not designed controls to ensure all accounting journals entries are reviewed and
approved and (ii) we have one individual in our accounting department who has &#8220;super user&#8221; access and security administration
rights to the financial reporting systems.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">To
remediate these material weaknesses, we are working to do the following: (i) implementing appropriate controls for accounting journal
entry approvals, including the approval of our chief financial officer, and (ii) either actively monitoring any accounting user with
elevated rights or assigning another employee outside of an accounting and reporting role with elevated access. We will not be able to
fully remediate the material weakness until the actions discussed above have been implemented and operated effectively for a sufficient
period of time.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Given
we are neither an accelerated filer nor a large accelerated filer, we are not required to include an attestation report regarding the
effectiveness of our internal controls over financial reporting of our independent registered public accounting firm in our Annual Report.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial
Reporting Process</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
have not designed controls to ensure the financial reporting process is operating effectively, as noted above. We intend to design controls
to ensure the financial information is accurate, complete, and recorded in the correct period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Change
in Internal Control over Financial Reporting</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">There
have been no changes in our internal control over financial reporting during the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 that have materially
affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect, our internal control over financial reporting.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="item_015"></span>Item
9B. Other Information</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Rule
10b5-1 Trading Plans</span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
information required by this Item is set forth under the headings &#8220;Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance&#8221;
and &#8220;Section 16(a) Beneficial Ownership Reporting Compliance&#8221; in the Company&#8217;s 2026 Proxy Statement to be filed with
the SEC within 120 days after December 31, 2025 in connection with the solicitation of proxies for the Company&#8217;s 2025 annual meeting
of shareholders and is incorporated herein by reference. The Company has&#160;adopted&#160;an insider trading policy which governs transactions
in our securities by the Company and its directors, officers, employees, any applicable consultants and contractors (as determined by
the Company), and each of their respective family members, and is designed to promote compliance with insider trading laws, rules and
regulations applicable to the Company. A copy of our insider trading policy is filed with this Annual Report on Form 10-K as Exhibit
19.1.</span></p>

Company has <span id="xdx_906_eecd--InsiderTrdPoliciesProcAdoptedFlag_dbT_c20250101__20251231_z3s94wKlOFOi"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" format="ixt:booleantrue" id="Fact001871" name="ecd:InsiderTrdPoliciesProcAdoptedFlag">adopted</ix:nonNumeric></span> a Code of Business Conduct and Ethics applicable to all officers, directors and employees, which is available on
the Company&#8217;s website (https://ir.nexgel.com/corporate-governance/governance-documents) under &#8220;Governance Documents.&#8221;
The Company intends to satisfy the disclosure requirement under Item&#160;5.05 of Form 8-K regarding amendment to, or waiver from, a
provision of its Code of Conduct by posting such information on the website address and location specified above.</span></p>
